linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Bokmål pass identified untranslated English side labels in trigonometry formulas and inconsistent labels in the worked example; all were corrected.

findings.summary: The three visible right-triangle formulas retained English side labels in the Bokmål presentation.
evidence: The formulas displayed opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse while the surrounding explanation used Norwegian terminology.
findings.resolution: Localized the formula labels to motstående side, hosliggende side, and hypotenusen.

findings.summary: The inverse-trigonometry formulas retained English side labels in the Bokmål presentation.
evidence: The formulas displayed opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse in an otherwise Norwegian section.
findings.resolution: Applied the same established Bokmål side terminology to all three inverse formulas.

findings.summary: The worked trigonometry example used abbreviated side labels that did not match the established terminology in the explanation.
evidence: The example used motstående and hosliggende, while the surrounding text identified the terms as motstående side and hosliggende side.
findings.resolution: Expanded both visible example labels to motstående side and hosliggende side.
